title: Scratchcards
description: Score scratchcards by matching numbers with cascading card copies.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse each card's winning numbers and owned numbers into sets. Count matches via set intersection.

## Part 1

Each card scores `2^(matches-1)` points (0 points for no matches). Sum all scores.

## Part 2

Instead of points, each match on card `i` gives you one copy of each of the next `matches` cards. Process cards in order, tracking how many copies of each card exist. Each copy contributes its own cascade. The answer is the total number of cards.
